items.zh: 全新界面：侧边栏布局，模式移到了每个应用页的顶部
items.en: Redesigned interface with a sidebar; modes now sit at the top of each app page

items.zh: 聚合模式：多家供应商的模型放进同一个模型列表，在客户端里随手切换
items.en: Aggregation: models from several providers in one picker, switchable inside your client

items.zh: 会话管理重写：每一轮做了什么、改了什么、哪步失败，一目了然
items.en: Rewritten sessions: see what each turn did, what it changed and where it failed

items.zh: 切换供应商只替换地址、凭据、模型等关键字段，自定义配置不再丢失
items.en: Switching providers only replaces the URL, credentials and model; custom settings are no longer lost
